description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Reads metadata fields: age_days, last_updated_timestamp, update_frequency_days, release_count, registry_source. Computes temporal stability score by penalizing very new (<7 days) and very stale (>365 days) servers while rewarding consistent update patterns. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Returns evidence dict with per-field partial scores.
